Task 20 decisions (owner + PM, 2026-10-18) · all 10 clashes resolved
  • 1 Resolved Ofsted tops stay (1c); places get their own muted palette that repeats no Ofsted, collision, station or tree colour.
  • 2 Resolved Cycle lanes sky dashes on cream casing; tangerine only for collisions; My places are ink pins with a glyph.
  • 3 Resolved barbell, swimming, glass-cocktail drawn. Sales: plum squares. Folds carry a glyph. Trees: heat ≤ z15, dots z16+ (Task 3).

4 · Clash list · pairs that read alike
#SeverityStatusReads alikeWhyFix
1HighResolveddecision 1
After
Ofsted cap tops and place badges use the same hexes: Outstanding = Sport & culture #009e73, Good = Shops #0072b2; Inadequate #c0352c ≈ Food #d55e00. At z15 a green disc beside a green-topped cap reads as one fact.resolved: caps keep the 1c colours; places get their own muted palette (ΔE ≥ 14 from every reserved colour); shape backs it (felt disc + pictogram vs cap).
2HighResolveddecision 2 + ink pins
After
Serious collision, cycle lanes and the “gym” My-places dot are all tangerine #f28b30, and collisions sit on the same roads as the lanes.resolved: cycle lanes sky dashes on a cream casing; My places become ink pins (gym = barbell glyph). Tangerine now means collisions only. Route yarn for cycling follows the lanes (sky).
3HighResolveddecision 3
After
Area page places list asks for barbell (gyms), swimming (pools) and glass-cocktail (bars); none is in thread-icons.ts, so all three draw the “Other” loop.resolved: barbell, swimming, glass-cocktail drawn in the thread set; add a unit test that every icon name used exists.
4MediumResolvedsquares + plum ramp
After
Sales pins use red–green RdYlGn: £2.5m red ≈ fatal cherry, cheap greens ≈ tree dots and green streets. All are small round dots.resolved: sales pins become 10 px rounded squares (house footprint) on a one-hue mauve-plum ramp (ΔE ≥ 14 from every reserved colour); red = collisions, green = nature.
5MediumResolvedink pins · shape
After
My places are plain 18 px dots in cherry / sun: “Work” reads as a collision, “School” as a slight collision or a not-inspected cap. Slight collisions (sun #f6c445) also share the cap body yellow.resolved: My places become ink teardrop pins with a white glyph (work, school, gym, family, other), label on; no cherry or sun. Slight collision stays (C is final): the burst shape and white glyph separate it from the cap, and caps outrank bursts so they never touch.
6MediumResolvedglyph bubbles3+312+4
After3+3+4
Three count/number bubbles mean different things: rank “3” (ink disc), school fold “+3” (white pill), tree cluster “12” (green disc).resolved: tree clusters removed (Task 3); fold bubbles carry their layer glyph (mini cap / sparkle) before “+N”; rank keeps the ink disc and never starts with “+”.
7LowResolvedshape + priorityCentral line ring red ≈ fatal burst; Circle line ring yellow ≈ cap yellow. Shapes differ (ring with white centre).resolved: shape backs colour (ring with a white centre vs burst vs cap); collisions get the lowest symbol-sort-key, below stations and caps, so a burst never touches either.
8LowResolvedshape + priorityRed Diamond plaque = cherry #e2453c (fatal); Ruby #9a1b4b ≈ Metropolitan #9B0058. A plaque on a cap corner can look like a burst behind it.resolved: plaques are gems with a number and a white halo, only ever on a cap corner; collisions never overlap caps (priority rule, row 7).
9LowResolvedhalo, no changePrivate cap body is DS ink #22252c; on the Night map (#121a30) only the white halo and top carry it.resolved: no colour change (1c final): the 2.6-unit white halo outlines the body on Night and the white top carries the shape; checked at 1× and 2× on the Night map (section 1).
10LowResolvedhelp redrawn
After
UI pairs that read alike at 20 px: help vs info (circle + glyph), star vs sparkle (My match), train vs tube.resolved: help redrawn as a speech bubble with “?” (info keeps the ring); sparkle (4 points + satellite) and star (5 points) stay, used in disjoint places; tube = Underground, train = rail.
